svg.title: A 99% accurate test that is wrong 92% of the time
svg.desc: A whiteboard sketch showing ten thousand people as one long rectangle with a tiny red sliver of ten actual cases, brackets leading down to a small green bar of nine true positives beside a red bar drawn ten times longer holding 101 false positives, with the precision worked out as eight percent; a curve of precision collapsing from 0.985 at 13.4 percent prevalence to 0.040 at 0.01 percent on a real spam classifier whose sensitivity and specificity never changed; the odds form of Bayes' theorem worked through to one in twenty-four; and the claim that a model is ninety-nine percent accurate crossed out in red.
svg.text: A 99% accurate test that is wrong 92% of the time
